pieces.promotesToTokinWhichMoves: Promotes to と金 (tokin), which moves like a gold.
pieces.anyNumberOfSquaresStraight: Any number of squares straight forward. It cannot go back or sideways.
pieces.promotesToWhichMovesLike: Promotes to 成香, which moves like a gold.
pieces.jumpsTwoSquaresForwardAnd: Jumps two squares forward and one to the side, over any piece. Only forward.
pieces.promotesToWhichMovesLike2: Promotes to 成桂, which moves like a gold.
pieces.oneSquareForwardOrOne: One square forward, or one square diagonally in any direction.
pieces.promotesToWhichMovesLike3: Promotes to 成銀, which moves like a gold.
pieces.oneSquareInAnyDirection: One square in any direction except diagonally backward.
pieces.promotesToHorseABishop: Promotes to 龍馬 (horse): a bishop that can also step one square up, down or sideways.
pieces.anyNumberOfSquaresUp: Any number of squares up, down or sideways.
pieces.promotesToDragonARook: Promotes to 龍王 (dragon): a rook that can also step one square diagonally.
pieces.oneSquareInAnyDirection2: One square in any direction. Checkmate the other king to win.
pieces.movesLikeAGoldIf: Moves like a gold. If captured, it goes back to being a plain pawn.
pieces.anyNumberOfSquaresDiagonally2: Any number of squares diagonally, plus one square up, down or sideways.
pieces.anyNumberOfSquaresUp2: Any number of squares up, down or sideways, plus one square diagonally.
pieces.aPieceMayPromoteWhen: A piece may promote when it moves into, out of, or inside the last three ranks.
pieces.aCapturedPieceIsYours: A captured piece is yours: drop it on any empty square instead of moving. You cannot drop a pawn on a file where you already have an unpromoted pawn, or drop a pawn to give checkmate.

settings.engineHint: Used for analysis, hints and the AI opponent. YaneuraOu K-P is built in. YaneuraOu NNUE needs an evaluation file (nn.bin, HalfKP 256x2-32-32, e.g. Suisho5 or tanuki- Háo) loaded from your computer; it stays in this browser. Fairy-Stockfish uses its built-in classical evaluation and is the weakest.
settings.fvScaleHint: Scale the net was trained for: Suisho5 24, Háo 20, most others 16.
settings.powerModeHint: Light beams and explosions on captures, a dramatic 王手, and a big finale on 詰み.
